title: Galvanic Cells
description: A reaction split in two, the electrons made to go round by a wire: its free energy comes out as a voltage, ΔG = −nFE. Unlocks the Fuel Cell, the Vanadium Flow Battery and the chlor-alkali cell.

puzzle.goal: A cell of standard voltage E passes n electrons per reaction, at temperature T, with reaction quotient Q. Write its voltage v, with the gas constant R and the Faraday constant F.
puzzle.name: Nernst
puzzle.form: E - R * T / ( n * F ) * ln ( Q )
puzzle.expr: E - R * T / ( n * F ) * ln ( Q )
puzzle.ask: Find v for E = @{E} V, R = 8.314, T = @{T} K, n = @{n}, F = 96485 and Q = @{Q}.
puzzle.method: ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q, and ΔG = −nFE: divide through by −nF.
